result.page_summary_en: This is an officials-and-military page from the ninth fascicle (第九) of the Hansei Ichiran-hyō, read right-to-left. The primary domain is Yatabe (○谷田部藩), whose full official roster is printed: one governor (知事 一人), one senior councillor (大参事 一人), three acting senior councillors (権大参事 三人), and four junior councillors (少参事 四人), together with eight named appointees (Kumagai Ichinoshin the governor, the public-assembly delegate Kumagai Teizō, Ōhinata Kiyohiro, Mitsuoka Kinzaemon, Ido Tōshirō, Nakamura Yūzō, Sekiguchi Tanzō, and Magome Tadashichirō); Yatabe's troop strength is recorded as not detailed (兵隊未詳). The page also carries the opening entries for two neighbouring domains: Yachi (○谷地藩), for which officials and troop numbers are both undetailed (職員兵數不詳), and Matsue (○松江藩), which shows a governor (知事 一人) with its remaining data continuing onto the next page. A caption at left names the fascicle and its three domains (谷田部、谷地、松江), and the bottom margin bears the printed book page number 391.
